Bottom line: FINAL_REPORT.mdThe production: PROTOCOL.md. This is a standalone new series on fixed fresh entrances. Accepted SEQ-01..09 remain unchanged.

Polynomials strictly certified by lattice SEQ-09, transform first They're very precise, rational operations on strings, high-grade monoma The resulting linear constraints are solved before Gröbner. Reversible transformation and certificate of equality of line spaces are preserved.

From the root of the project, PowerShell:

Executable code/The commands are omitted in the documentary copy.

Integrity first, then continuation Timeouts, they don't automatically count JOURNAL.jsonl It's finished. A new series requires a new folder; accepted results are not overwritten.

  • degree_solver.pycertificate T*A=H, det(T) != 0, affinity exception, Residual system solution, if necessary.
  • coupled_solver.py, difference_solver.py, solver.py, mobius.py, translation_decoder.py: byte copies of accepted implementations.
  • data.py: only used make_packet; list seed situated new experiment.py, old-school data.cases He's not called.
  • inputs/: 24 New entrances; truth is not transmitted to restoration.
  • results/primalold heuristics SEQ-08; results/prepare: one common the coefficient grating to the entrance; results/raw and results/degree: Two solvers of the same polynomials with the same algebra limit.
  • lattices/, algebra/, progress/Accurate certificates and steps.
  • arithmetic.py, ARITHMETIC.json: 16 exhaustive 6 Special controls.
  • audit.py, polynomial_audit.py, inherited_audit.py, audit_common.py: independent review; previous main They're not called.
  • AUDIT.json, audit_packets/: the results of the inspections.
  • CONTROLS.json, MEASUREMENTS.json, COMPARISON.json: coating, pair differences, separate preparation time and algebra.
  • REAL.json: only the structure of real masks and future search tolerances.
  • PROVENANCE.json, PRIOR_SNAPSHOT.json, ENVIRONMENT.json: origin, SHA256/mtime previous files and hashes of existing dependencies.
  • RESUME_CHECK.json, ACCEPTANCE.json, COMPLETE.json, ARTIFACTS.json: Continuation without computation, acceptance and integrity.

One computational CPU-process. Python 3.11.9, python-flint 0.9.0, SymPy 1.14.0. No GPU The overall scientific budget 900 seconds; before 45 momentarily primal/prepare, before 15 momentarily raw/degree. Completion of the process can slightly increase the measured wall time. The audit is performed separately, until 120 Just a second to enter.
